verdict.rationale: Vercel's first-party docs describe AI Gateway as one managed endpoint for calling hundreds of models. It is callable via the AI SDK, any OpenAI-compatible SDK, or cURL, and adds fallbacks across providers, budgets/spend controls, usage monitoring, centralized credentials, and no markup on token prices. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the gateway works as claimed, and a concrete model list or count backing "hundreds" (only vendor claims).
